description: Find patch series by parsing [PATCH v2 3/7]-style subject prefixes. Returns structured patch metadata including version, sequence, total, and series grouping. complete=false when it ran out of budget_ms.

budget_ms.description: Time budget in ms (100-15000, default 10000). complete=false when it ran out.

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

query.description: Additional search query to filter patches

name: search_patches
